about: Batch identity hashes an item's images in canonical form: the content type and the decoded bytes. The first request sends a one-pixel PNG as a data: URL; the re-send carries the same batch_id and the same PNG as {content_type, base64} without padding. Both have one identity, so the re-send is a replay, not batch_id_reuse. The malformed request's image is not base64, so validation refuses it before any provider call, naming the one image; the message after the colon is the decoder's own.
